descriptions.text: Tar paper, pigeon bones, laundry that gave up. A transmission cable thick as a wrist hangs skinned and humming between you and the watchtower to the north. South drops to the canal.

obstacles.fail: North is the cable. It is live. Your teeth know before your hands do. Insulated gloves or a different life.
obstacles.pass: Gloves on, you shoulder under the live cable. The watchtower roof takes your weight.
